subject: Media Literacy
title: Social Media Rewrites the Rules
description: A quick, practical guide to Social Media Rewrites the Rules.

hook.text: Facebook launched in a dorm room in 2004. By 2024, it had 3 billion monthly users.

buildup.text: Social media platforms turned every user into both a consumer and a broadcaster of content.

discovery.text: Algorithms replaced editors, deciding what billions of people see based on what keeps them scrolling.

twist.text: The platforms are free because you're not the customer — you're the product being sold to advertisers.

climax.text: Social media gave everyone a voice but optimized for outrage, not truth.

punchline.text: The algorithm doesn't care if it's true. Just engaging.

quiz.question: Why are most social media platforms free to use?
options: Users are the product sold to advertisers
